sourceBoundary: Comic Book Herald's two printed issue sequences in printed order: Fall of the Hulks Reading Order (positions 1 to 16) then World War Hulks (positions 17 to 29). The trade reading order above them lists collected editions and is not part of the selected vector. Fall of the Hulks: MODOK #1 at position 3 is kept as an open published-metadata gap.

sourceGaps.sourceGroup: Fall of the Hulks Reading Order
sourceGaps.auditBasis: The source places Fall of the Hulks: MODOK #1, which it calls a digital-only release, third in the Fall of the Hulks order. The vendored series index has no Fall of the Hulks: MODOK series; its only M.O.D.O.K. titles are M.O.D.O.K.: Reign Delay and Modok's 11. The provider search for Fall of the Hulks returned 9 issues (Alpha, Gamma, Red Hulk 1 to 4 and Savage She-Hulks 1 to 3) without the MODOK one-shot, MODOK returned only the 6 Modok's 11 issues, and Fall of the Hulks MODOK and MODOK 2010 returned 0. Searches with periods in M.O.D.O.K. returned HTTP 500 and are not counted as evidence. This bounds only these queries, not publication, provider-wide metadata or subscription availability, and no Marvel issue id is inferred. An unconfirmed search-index candidate, 32756, returned HTTP 404 from the provider detail endpoint on 2026-11-07 UTC; it is not adopted as the comic identity.

proposedManifest.name: Fall of the Hulks and World War Hulks
proposedManifest.description: Follow Comic Book Herald's Fall of the Hulks and World War Hulks order across Hulk, Incredible Hulks and the event one-shots. The MODOK one-shot is not included because its metadata could not be resolved.
proposedManifest.sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide

sourceReview.rationale: The owner approved all 29 source positions, 28 exact identities, the MODOK metadata gap and the four reviewed title translations. The decision is recorded at https://github.com/raymond-nassar/recap-page/issues/1156#issuecomment-6703273841.
